title: Reduced Layer Count with Enhanced Thickness Freedom
scientific_hypothesis: An 18-layer TiO2/SiO2 stack with fully free thickness optimization can match or exceed the performance of a 24-layer quarter-wave-initialized design, because optimization freedom compensates for reduced interface count.
design_principle: Non-quarter-wave stacks can achieve similar spectral selectivity with fewer layers if thicknesses are optimized globally rather than constrained to quarter-wave values. This tests whether layer count or thickness optimization freedom is the dominant factor.
proposed_topology: Air | (TiO2 | SiO2) × 9 | Fused Silica Substrate - 18 layers total, starting with TiO2
design_variables: individual layer thicknesses for all 18 layers
manufacturing_considerations: 18 layers reduces deposition time and stress compared to 24 layers
Fewer interfaces may improve yield and adhesion
Thickness tolerance requirements may be tighter with fewer layers
expected_advantages: Tests whether optimization can compensate for fewer layers
known_risks: May not achieve same band separation as 24-layer design
Optimization landscape may be more complex without quarter-wave initialization
Polarization splitting at 45° may be harder to manage with fewer degrees of freedom
execution_request_english: Optimize an 18-layer dielectric coating on fused silica substrate at 45° incidence. Stack sequence: TiO2 (Siefke), SiO2 (Gao), TiO2 (Siefke), SiO2 (Gao), TiO2 (Siefke), SiO2 (Gao), TiO2 (Siefke), SiO2 (Gao), TiO2 (Siefke), SiO2 (Gao), TiO2 (Siefke), SiO2 (Gao), TiO2 (Siefke), SiO2 (Gao), TiO2 (Siefke), SiO2 (Gao), TiO2 (Siefke), SiO2 (Gao) (18 layers total, starting with TiO2 (Siefke) adjacent to air). Materials: TiO2 (Siefke) and SiO2 (Gao) from catalogue. Substrate: SiO2 (Gao) (fused silica). Incident medium: air. Wavelength bands: 450-650 nm (target high reflectance), 700-1000 nm (target high transmittance). Angle: 45 degrees. Design variables: all 18 layer thicknesses in nanometers. Initialize thicknesses near quarter-wave optical thickness at 675 nm center wavelength, then optimize all thicknesses freely. Maximum 24 layers constraint is satisfied with margin.
